other_conditions: Must be a resident of Odisha
Must have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law
Must not have been convicted of any criminal offense involving moral turpitude
Must not be in receipt of any other pension from the Union Government, the State Government or any organization aided by either Government

Applicant must be either a construction worker aged 60 years or above, a widow (any age), a widow of a registered construction worker, a leprosy patient with visible deformity, a physically challenged person, a widow of a HIV‑positive worker, or an HIV‑positive construction worker
benefits_summary: ₹500 per month up to age 80, and ₹700 per month for beneficiaries aged 80 and above
